messages:
Leah: Quick check — proposal to soft-launch GA to 3 cap-exempt pilot customers tomorrow. Two open questions: manual billing override workflow and whether we can ship without the automated cap-exempt path. Need owners and clear GO/NO-GO criteria.
Omar: Infra can add a feature flag to gate the automation and expose a manual operator path. ETA ~2h if nothing blocks.
Nina: From billing side, automation requires signed-contract flag in ledger. Without that, billing CLI can do a manual zero-rate override. Who has the contract list?
Priya: I own the pilot customer list. Legal flagged a short addendum they want for cap-exempt billing; they said it's low risk but prefer wording. Can we do manual override as a stopgap?
Leah: Proposed decision: ship soft-launch for pilot customers with manual overrides only, documented prominently as "pilot/manual billing" in Console + docs. Delay automation until legal signoff. Opinions?
Omar: +1 if we feature-flag it and provide a safe manual rollback. I'll also add a metric for operator overrides.
Nina: I'll draft the billing playbook and include step-by-step override commands and audit checks.
Priya: I'll draft customer comms: explicitly call out pilot status, manual billing, and limits. I'll attach the contract list.
Carlos: Monitoring ask: add pilot_billing_override_count and a dashboard tile showing which accounts have overrides and cost deltas. Who owns dashboard?
Leah: @Omar can you add the metric? @Nina can you add the runbook snippet and sample audit query?
Nina: On it. Runbook snippet will include this quick command for ops:
```
# manual billing override
billingctl accounts set-rate --account acct-pilot-42 --rate 0
billingctl audit show --account acct-pilot-42 --since 24h
```
Also will include rollback steps to revert with `--rate default`.
Priya: Acceptance criteria for soft-launch GO: (1) manual override playbook published, (2) feature flag in place, (3) metric & dashboard tile added, (4) customer comms drafted. Legal addendum must be in progress (signoff within 72h). If all true, GO.
eng-oncall-bot: Heads-up: maintenance window 2026-03-22T02:00Z may cause brief latency spikes.
Leah: Risk gating: if any pilot sees cost increases >20% or token latency regressions >15% we abort and rollback. Priya: agreed.
billing-bot: Test override applied by Nina for acct-pilot-42 (test) at 1734121000  audit-id 9876.
Carlos: Dashboard tile created in /console/dashboards/pilot-billing-overrides. Link posted.
Leah: Owners recap: Omar -> feature flag + metric; Nina -> billing playbook + runbook snippet; Priya -> customer comms + contract list; Carlos -> dashboard tile; Leah -> legal follow-up + coordinate final GO. Check-in in 3h.
Priya: If legal cannot give addendum within 72h we still consider shipping to pilots only with explicit manual exceptions and signed acknowledgement per account. Will escalate if needed.
Leah: Thanks team. Keep updates in thread and ping me for any blocker. :white_check_mark:
